sentences.korean: 德雷克捡起了那条虫子。
sentences.details:
[[pick]]
pick / pɪk / 픽 / 고르다, 따다
[V / 动词] 选择, 采摘, 捡
pick / picked / picked / picking

Pick a color you like.
I will pick some flowers.
Do not pick your nose.

选一个你喜欢的颜色。
我要去摘些花。
不要挖鼻子。

[[pick up]]
pick up / pɪk ʌp / 픽 업 / 집어 들다, 태워 주다
[V / 动词] 拾起, 接送
pick up / picked up / picked up / picking up

Please pick up the trash.
I pick up my brother.
Can you pick up the phone?

请捡起垃圾。
我去接我的弟弟。
你能接一下电话吗？

[[little]]
little / ˈlɪtl / 리틀 / 작은, 어린
[Adj / 形容词] 小的, 年幼的

I have a little dog.
The little girl is crying.
Give me a little water.

我有一只小狗。
那个小女孩在哭。
给我一点水。

[[guy]]
guy / ɡaɪ / 가이 / 남자, 사람
[N / 名词] 男家伙, 人

That guy is my teacher.
Who is the tall guy?
He is a very nice guy.

那个家伙是我的老师。
那个高个子是谁？
他是一个很好的人。

sentences.english: Then he put the worm back in the dirt.
sentences.korean: 然后他把虫子放回了土里。
sentences.details:
[[then]]
then / ðen / 덴 / 그때, 그러고 나서
[Adv / 副词] 当时, 然后

I was a baby then.
Eat first, then play.
If it rains, then stay.

我那时还是个婴儿。
先吃饭，然后玩。
如果下雨，那就留下。

[[put]]
put / pʊt / 풋 / 놓다, 두다
[V / 动词] 放, 安置
put / put / put / putting

Put the book on the desk.
I put sugar in my milk.
Where did you put it?

把书放在桌子上。
我在牛奶里放了糖。
你把它放哪儿了？

[[put back]]
put back / pʊt bæk / 풋 백 / 제자리에 갖다 놓다
[V / 动词] 放回原处
put back / put back / put back / putting back

Put back the toy now.
I put back the milk.
Please put it back here.

现在把玩具放回去。
我把牛奶放回去了。
请把它放回这里。

[[dirt]]
dirt / dɜːrt / 더트 / 먼지, 흙
[N / 名词] 泥土, 污垢

Wash the dirt off your hands.
The plant needs some dirt.
There is dirt on the floor.

洗掉手上的泥。
这棵植物需要一些土。
地板上有污垢。

sentences.english: "Are you Drake?" a loud voice asked behind him.
sentences.korean: “你是德雷克吗？”身后一个响亮的声音问道。
sentences.details:
[[loud]]
loud / laʊd / 라우드 / 소리가 큰, 시끄러운
[Adj / 形容词] 大声的, 响亮的

The music is too loud.
He has a loud voice.
Do not be so loud.

音乐太大声了。
他的声音很大。
不要这么大声。

[[voice]]
voice / vɔɪs / 보이스 / 목소리
[N / 名词] 声音, 嗓音

I like your voice.
She has a sweet voice.
Speak in a low voice.

我喜欢你的声音。
她的嗓音很甜。
请低声说话。

[[behind]]
behind / bɪˈhaɪnd / 비하인드 / 뒤에
[Prep / 介词] 在...后面

The cat is behind the door.
I am behind you.
Look behind the tree.

猫在门后面。
我在你后面。
看树后面。

sentences.korean: 德雷克吓了一跳，转过身来。
sentences.details:
[[jump]]
jump / dʒʌmp / 점프 / 뛰다, 점프하다
[V / 动词], [N / 名词] 跳跃
jump / jumped / jumped / jumping

Can you jump high?
The frogs jump in the water.
I jump for joy.

你能跳得高吗？
青蛙跳进水里。
我高兴得跳了起来。

[[turn]]
turn / tɜːrn / 턴 / 돌다, 차례
[V / 动词], [N / 名词] 转动, 轮流
turn / turned / turned / turning

Turn the key to the right.
It is my turn to play.
Turn left at the shop.

向右转动钥匙。
轮到我玩了。
在商店向左转。

[[turn around]]
turn around / tɜːrn əˈraʊnd / 턴 어라운드 / 몸을 돌리다, 뒤돌아보다
[V / 动词] 转身, 回头
turn around / turned around / turned around / turning around

Turn around and look at me.
I had to turn around.
The car turned around.

转身看着我。
我不得不转身。
汽车掉头了。

[[around]]
around / əˈraʊnd / 어라운드 / 주위에, 사방에
[Prep / 介词], [Adv / 副词] 在...周围, 到处

We ran around the park.
Look around the room.
The Earth goes around the Sun.

我们在公园周围跑步。
环视房间。
地球绕着太阳转。

sentences.english: One of the king's soldiers rode up on a black horse.
sentences.korean: 国王的一名士兵骑着一匹黑马跑了过来。
sentences.details:
[[ride]]
ride / raɪd / 라이드 / 타다, 타고 가다
[V / 动词], [N / 名词] 骑, 乘坐
ride / rode / ridden / riding

I ride my bike to school.
Can I ride the horse?
The bus ride is long.

我骑自行车去上学。
我可以骑马吗？
坐公交车的路程很长。

[[ride up]]
ride up / raɪd ʌp / 라이드 업 / 말 타고 오다, (옷이) 위로 올라가다
[V / 动词] 骑马前来, (衣服)向上卷缩
ride up / rode up / ridden up / riding up

The knight rode up to us.
My shirt rides up often.
They rode up the hill.

骑士骑马向我们走来。
我的衬衫经常向上缩。
他们骑马上了山。

[[beard]]
beard / bɪrd / 비어드 / 턱수염
[N / 名词] 胡须

Santa has a white beard.
My dad grows a beard.
He touched his long beard.

圣诞老人有白胡子。
我爸爸留了胡子。
他摸了摸他的长胡子。

sentences.english: His shirt had a gold dragon sewn on it, the symbol of King Roland the Bold.
sentences.korean: 他的衬衫上缝着一条金龙，那是勇敢的罗兰国王的标志。
sentences.details:
[[shirt]]
shirt / ʃɜːrt / 셔츠 / 셔츠, 윗옷
[N / 名词] 衬衫

I like your blue shirt.
Put on a clean shirt.
The shirt has a pocket.

我喜欢你的蓝色衬衫。
穿上一件干净的衬衫。
这件衬衫有一个口袋。

[[dragon]]
dragon / ˈdræɡən / 드래곤 / 용
[N / 名词] 龙

The dragon can fly.
I read a story about a dragon.
Is the dragon scary?

龙会飞。
我读了一个关于龙的故事。
龙可怕吗？

[[sewn]]
sewn / soʊn / 소운 / 꿰맨, 바느질한
[V / 动词], [Adj / 形容词] 缝合的
sew / sewed / sewn / sewing

The button is sewn on well.
I have a sewn bag.
My mom has sewn this for me.

纽扣缝得很牢。
我有一个缝制的包。
我妈妈为我缝了这个。

[[symbol]]
symbol / ˈsɪmbl / 심볼 / 상징, 기호
[N / 名词] 象征, 符号

The heart is a symbol of love.
What does this symbol mean?
The flag is our symbol.

心是爱的象征。
这个符号是什么意思？
国旗是我们的象征。

sentences.english: "Yes, I'm Drake," Drake said, his voice shaking.
sentences.korean: “是的，我是德雷克，”德雷克说，声音在发抖。
sentences.details:
[[shake]]
shake / ʃeɪk / 쉐이크 / 흔들다, 흔들리다
[V / 动词] 摇动, 抖动
shake / shook / shaken / shaking

Shake the bottle of juice.
They shake hands.
The ground began to shake.

摇一摇这瓶果汁。
他们握手。
地面开始摇晃。

sentences.english: Soldiers never came to the fields.
sentences.details:
[[never]]
never / ˈnevər / 네버 / 결코 ~않다
[Adv / 副词] 从不, 绝不

I never eat meat.
He is never late.
Never say never.

我从不吃肉。
他从不迟到。
永不言弃。

[[field]]
field / fiːld / 필드 / 들판, 밭, 분야
[N / 名词] 田野, 领域

The cows are in the field.
We play in the green field.
He is an expert in this field.

牛在田野里。
我们在绿色的田野里玩耍。
他是这个领域的专家。

[[fields]]
fields / fiːldz / 필즈 / 들판들, 밭들
[N / 名词] 田野, 牧场 (复数)

The flowers cover the fields.
Farmers work in the fields.
Look at the gold fields.

鲜花覆盖了田野。
农民们在田里干活。
看看那些金色的田野。

sentences.english: Not unless a farmer was in trouble.
sentences.details:
[[unless]]
unless / ənˈles / 언레스 / ~하지 않으면
[Conj / 连词] 除非, 如果不

I will stay home unless you come.
Do not go out unless you wear a coat.
I cannot help you unless you tell me.

除非你来，否则我会呆在家里。
如果不穿外套就别出去。
除非你告诉我，否则我帮不了你。

[[not unless]]
not unless / nɑːt ənˈles / 낫 언레스 / ~하지 않으면 안돼.
[Phrase / 短语] 除非...否则不

Can I go? Not unless you finish.
Will it work? Not unless you try.
Is he coming? Not unless it stops raining.

我能走吗？除非你做完，否则不行。
这行得通吗？除非你尝试，否则不行。
他会来吗？除非雨停了，否则不会。

[[trouble]]
trouble / ˈtrʌbl / 트러블 / 문제, 고통, 괴롭히다
[N / 名词], [V / 动词] 麻烦, 困难, 烦恼
trouble / troubled / troubled / troubling

I am in big trouble.
The car has engine trouble.
Do not trouble yourself.

我遇到大麻烦了。
汽车引擎有故障。
不要自找麻烦。

In love: 恋爱中 (恋爱状态)
In a hurry: 匆忙中 (匆忙状态)
In danger: 处在危险中 (危险状态)
In trouble: 遇上麻烦 (麻烦状态)
